powershell -Command "$json = $input | Out-String; if ($json -match 'git push' -and $json -notmatch 'push --dry-run') { $branch = (git branch --show-current 2>$null); Write-Host ''; Write-Host '⚠️  GIT PUSH DETECTED' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host "   Branch: $branch" -ForegroundColor Cyan; if ($branch -eq 'main' -or $branch -eq 'master') { Write-Host '   🔴 PUSHING DIRECTLY TO MAIN — are you sure?' -ForegroundColor Red } else { Write-Host '   Pushing to: ' -NoNewline -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host $branch -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '   Review the branch above before confirming.' -ForegroundColor DarkGray; Write-Host '' }"
